main_measure.name: mean of forecast x drift-removed 8-bar return, pooled
main_measure.threshold: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting check passes confirms; mean < 0 with t <= -2 rejects; fewer than 300 cases inconclusive

supporting_check.name: drift-removed 8-bar return, above-median forecast minus below-median

decided_by: The main-measure mean is > 0 with t >= 2 and the supporting check passes.
reading: The settlement bar is the bar whose close (start + 1h) is 16:00 UTC, the 8-bar return is taken 8 rows ahead inside the window, the median is pooled over all cases with cases equal to it left out of both halves, and the 300-case minimum is treated as the plan's minimum count (not observable).
